description: Defines the QuicPacketNumber class for representing and manipulating QUIC protocol packet numbers, including initialization, comparison, arithmetic operations, and logging.

classes.name: QuicPacketNumber
classes.description: Represents a QUIC packet number, which can be initialized or uninitialized, with methods for comparison, arithmetic, and conversion.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Resets the packet number to uninitialized state.

methods.name: UpdateMax
methods.description: Updates the packet number to the maximum of its current value and a new value.

methods.name: Hash
methods.description: Returns a hash of the packet number.

methods.name: ToUint64
methods.description: Converts the packet number to a uint64_t.

methods.name: IsInitialized
methods.description: Checks if the packet number is initialized.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string representation of the packet number.
